assertions.name: mirror_difference_collapses_to_the_exact_identity
assertions.source: c1(Z,N) - c1(N,Z) == (Z-N)*(5*2^-(A+1) - 13*4^-A) as exact Fractions, for every (Z,N) with Z,N >= 1 and A = 2..24 (275 pairs). The census term contributes 5(Z-N) and the interface term -8(Z-N), both times 4^-A; the whole isospin dependence of c1 is this one bracket.

assertions.name: bracket_is_negative_at_A2_and_positive_for_every_A_at_least_3
assertions.source: 5*2^-(A+1) - 13*4^-A = 4^-A (5*2^(A-1) - 13): at A=2, 5*2 = 10 < 13 so it is -3/16 < 0; at A=3, 5*4 = 20 > 13 so it is 7/64 > 0, and 2^(A-1) only grows. So for every A >= 3 the trace channel predicts the PROTON-RICH mirror (Z > N) binds MORE.

assertions.name: prediction_and_observation_disagree_in_sign_for_EVERY_mirror_pair
assertions.source: for each AME 2020 mirror pair with Z > N and A >= 3, the sign of c1(Z,N) - c1(N,Z) against the sign of B(Z,N) - B(N,Z). The prediction is positive for every pair (bracket positive, Z > N); the observation is negative for every pair (Coulomb repulsion makes the proton-rich mirror less bound). Signs are compared, never magnitudes: no energy scale enters, so this is the one claim in this lane immune to the unpinned E_0 of bean qou-59j5.

assertions.name: the_disagreement_is_universal_not_a_sample_artifact
assertions.source: 230 pairs, spanning A = 3..99 and Z-N = 1..8; agreement 0. Not a selected subset — every mirror pair the AME table holds with both members present.

description: The derived c1 closed form predicts that the proton-rich member of a mirror pair binds MORE for every A >= 3, via the exact identity c1(Z,N) - c1(N,Z) = (Z-N)(5*2^-(A+1) - 13*4^-A). AME 2020 says the opposite in all 230 mirror pairs. Parameter-free and scale-free (a sign is invariant under any positive energy scale), so unlike every magnitude claim in this lane it survives the unpinned-E_0 problem of bean qou-59j5.

data.verdict: The derived c1 mirror asymmetry is WRONG IN SIGN for every one of the 230 AME mirror pairs with A >= 3. The prediction is exact and parameter-free — c1(Z,N) - c1(N,Z) = (Z-N) 4^-A (5*2^(A-1) - 13), positive for Z > N whenever A >= 3 — and the comparison is SCALE-FREE, since any positive energy scale preserves a sign. SCOPE (a): the trace channel alone, at leading order in hbar_q, gets the mirror asymmetry backwards. It is not a structural exclusion; no invariant is cited. What it localises is that the missing term must be charge-dependent and REPULSIVE, and must exceed the wrong-signed c1 contribution rather than merely supply the observed gap — i.e. the Coulomb term the corpus records as nowhere derived.
